## Hardware ads, for software — and people in the film

![Theme 101 Noise Cancelling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tugrawork-creator/saas-motion-kit/main/docs/theme-101.jpg)

### A new theme family: hardware-ad grammar
Minimal hardware product ads, translated into films for software. The first theme is **[101 Noise Cancelling](https://tugrawork-creator.github.io/saas-motion-kit/themes/101-noise-cancelling.html)**: 38 dashboards hum as hairline waveforms, the product opens a quiet zone, and exactly one signal breaks a cut to true silence.

### The human layer
Kit films can now include people: fictional, AI-generated, and never at the expense of the product. **The rule: every shot with a person also has a 3D move and a product beat.** [`creative/human-layer.md`](https://github.com/tugrawork-creator/saas-motion-kit/blob/main/creative/human-layer.md) has five formats (over-the-shoulder dive, portal cards, hand to interface, diorama presenter, metric on the face), a fal pipeline and the truth rules:

- Generated people are **actors, never customers**: no testimonials, no quotes.
- No real person's likeness.
- An AI credit on the end card.
- The screen always shows the real product UI, never generated pixels.

**Pilot: [Over-the-Shoulder Dive](https://github.com/tugrawork-creator/saas-motion-kit/tree/main/examples/human-layer-ots).** Deniz is on call at 23:40. The real Pulse UI is pinned onto the generated plate's green screen frame by frame, and the camera dives into a three-step 3D tutorial. A real finger taps Roll back, and we pull back to the face.

### New tools
- **`tools/fal_shots.py`** runs a film's `shots.json` on fal: Nano Banana 2 cast card → stills → Seedance 2.0 / Kling O3 Pro clips. It chains outputs, caches results and has a `--dry-run`.
- **`tools/screen_track.py`** tracks a green screen in a plate and writes per-frame corners, so real UI can be pinned onto it.
- **`placeholders.py`** writes stand-in plates, so the cut previews before any footage exists. Generated footage stays out of git; the repo keeps only the recipe.
- **Smaller fixes:** the gallery counts its own themes, and `make_thumbs.py --only NNN` renders just the thumbnails you changed.

Full notes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/tugrawork-creator/saas-motion-kit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

---

**TR:** v1.3 ile iki yenilik geldi. Birincisi "hardware-ad grammar" tema ailesi: sade donanım reklamlarının dili yazılıma uyarlanıyor, ilk tema 101 Noise Cancelling. İkincisi insan katmanı: AI ile üretilmiş kurgusal insanlar filmlere giriyor ama her insanlı çekim 3D bir hareket ve bir ürün adımı da taşıyor. Pilot film Omuz Üstü Dalış; fal üretim hattı ve yeşil ekran takibi de bu sürümde.

*Acme, its products and the people in its films are fictional.*
